results.content:
# Great UI- Still in Development

The UI for this app is about the best I’ve found for a local AI interface, however the feature to add a document or load context is completely broken for me as of now, which is a pretty important aspect for me. Also, even for models that support higher context length (such as Qwen 3.5 which says it supports 262k) the app still seems to limit you to 32k, which is a shame. Great app otherwise, clean, customizable, and easy to use

## What’s New

# Version History [...] ### Off Grid until it’s not

Really solid app in general with a few gripes. The minor one is the edit function is totally borked. Attempting to select text aside from the very end of the prompt causes the text menu to instead move out of the way and close the keyboard. To actually edit anything earlier in the prompt, you have to delete everything after it. The really awful thing is that the app calls itself “Off Grid” but has a built in, untoggleable web search tool that it uses within your chats without direct user prompting. You could be asking your model a private question and it will just throw your prompt into a search engine without your consent. What about that is “off grid”? Why is it not clearly surfaced to the user and able to be disabled?

results.title: Thorough Review of the Fully Local AI App 'Off Grid': Get a Private AI Environment on Your Smartphone Without the Cloud. Plus, Thoughts on the Future Beyond.｜ゆいまる‐IT界隈以外でAIを使いまくる2005年生まれ
results.content:
Overview: A free app compatible with both Android and iOS. Downloads small LLMs (Qwen, Gemma, Llama, etc.) from Hugging Face for offline execution.
 Strengths: Simple and beginner-friendly. You can download models and start chatting immediately after installation. Privacy-focused with data kept completely local.
 Weaknesses: Primarily text generation only. Image generation and vision AI are either unsupported or weak. Many Off Grid user reviews state, 'The text is good, but it is inferior to Off Grid in terms of multi-functionality.'
 Performance: Practical level on mid-range devices. It is lighter than Off Grid, but the hardware load is lower because it lacks image-based features. [...] Whether on an airplane, traveling abroad, in remote mountainous areas with poor signal, in countries with strict internet censorship, or during disasters, AI works on your smartphone in any environment.

Many tool-calling features (calculators or knowledge base searches) work completely offline, functioning as a survival tool in emergencies.

Furthermore, you are freed from the stress of 'monthly fees' and 'API limits'.

Models can be downloaded for free from Hugging Face, with unlimited generation.

For those frustrated by the 'pay-per-use' or 'usage limits' of cloud AI, an experience that is entirely self-contained on the hardware you own is revolutionary.

results.title: Avis Off Grid AI: IA locale sur 4 plateformes | PromptQuorum
results.content:
Off Grid AI, créé par Wednesday Solutions, Inc., est une application gratuite, open source et sans compte qui exécute des modèles d'IA ouverts entièrement sur l'appareil, sur quatre plateformes : iOS, Android, macOS et Windows. Selon le site du développeur, elle a dépassé 180 000 téléchargements cumulés entre l'App Store, Google Play et GitHub, et son client mobile, OGAM sur GitHub, compte plus de 3 000 étoiles sous licence MIT. La fiche App Store, elle seule, raconte une histoire plus modeste — Off Grid AI - Private Local AI affiche une moyenne de 3,1 étoiles sur seulement 26 avis, un signal faible isolément. Cet avis vérifie les deux images directement : les chiffres multiplateformes de téléchargements et d'étoiles de getoffgridai.co et GitHub, ainsi que la note iOS plus étroite de [...] →Application principale gratuite : sans compte, sans abonnement, sans cloud — vérifié sur getoffgridai.co.
 →Multiplateforme : iOS 17+, Android 10+, macOS 14+ (Apple Silicon) et Windows — pas seulement iOS.
 →Plus de 180 000 téléchargements cumulés et plus de 3 000 étoiles GitHub (dépôt OGAM sous licence MIT) selon le site du développeur, vérifié directement sur GitHub.
 →Le signal isolé de l'App Store est faible : Off Grid AI - Private Local AI affiche 3,1 étoiles sur 26 avis au moment de cet avis.
 →Off Grid AI Pro en option : 69 $ à vie ou 49 $/an selon la page de tarifs du développeur — les fonctions principales de chat, vision, génération d'images et voix n'en ont pas besoin.
